npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.dating_acce: You... really mean that? I was beginning to think I was the only one feeling this way. Yes, %player%. I'd love to be with you.
I was hoping you'd ask someday. You've made me happier than you probably realize. I'd be honored to call you mine.
Well, this is unexpected... but a very welcome surprise. Yes, I'd like that. Let's see where this road takes us.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.dating_deny: You're a dear friend, %player%, but I don't think my heart is in the same place as yours. I hope that won't change things between us.
I'm flattered, truly. But I don't think we're meant to be anything more than friends. I hope you understand.
I think highly of you, but romance isn't something I'm looking for right now. Please don't take it personally.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.default_gif: Oh, something for me? That's thoughtful of you. Thank you, I'll find a good use for it.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.dislike.1: Oh... well, thank you, I suppose. It's not quite my taste, but I appreciate the thought behind it.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.divorce.1: So this is where our paths part. I won't pretend it doesn't hurt, but I won't stand in your way either. Farewell, %player%.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.divorce.2: I see. If this is truly what you want, then I'll respect your decision. I hope you find whatever it is you're searching for.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.divorce.3: Perhaps we were never meant to walk the same road forever. I'll cherish the memories, even if we must make new ones apart.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.divorce_err: Divorce? %player%, we aren't even married! Are you trying to skip a few steps?
I'm afraid you'll need a spouse before you can get divorced. Unless you've discovered some rather unusual magic?
That's a rather dramatic request for someone who hasn't even put a ring on my finger.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.first.1: Well, look what the wind has carried to my doorstep. A stranger, and one who doesn't seem particularly dangerous. Yet.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.first.2: Greetings, traveler. You have the look of someone who's seen a few things beyond the safety of these walls.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.first.3: Oh? A visitor? It's been rather quiet around here lately. I suppose a little company wouldn't hurt.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.first.4: Hold there! ...Ah, you're not here to cause trouble, are you? My apologies. One can never be too careful these days.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.follow_no.1: I'd love to, but I have a few things to take care of here. Perhaps another time.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.follow_no.2: Not today, I'm afraid. My feet could use a little rest, and my bed is calling.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.follow_no.3: You'll have to manage without me this time. I've got some unfinished business to attend to.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.follow_stop: Already had enough of my company? Very well. I'll be around if you need me again.
Back to the quiet life, then. Try not to get yourself into too much trouble.
I'll leave you to it, %player%. It's been a pleasant journey. Take care.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.follow_talk: Need something, %player%? I'm right here. Try not to wander off without me this time.
It's a fine day for an adventure. Although I'd prefer one without too many explosions.
You lead the way. I'll keep my eyes open. Someone has to make sure we don't walk straight into trouble.
An adventure with you? Why not! Let me grab my things, and I'll be ready.
Count me in, %player%. Something tells me this will be more interesting than another day at home.
I'd be glad to join you. Just promise me we won't spend the entire journey underground.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.greeting.1: Ah, %player%! Good to see you again. Have the roads been kind to you?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.greeting.2: Well, if it isn't my favorite wandering adventurer. What brings you around this time?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.greeting.3: Greetings! I was just wondering when you'd show up. Not that I was waiting or anything.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.greeting.4: Good day to you, %player%. Anything interesting happening beyond the village?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.hate.1: You brought me this? I'd honestly rather have received nothing. Please don't make a habit of it.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.like.1: Oh, wow! I've always wanted something like this. Thank you, %player%!
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.marriage_ac: A lifetime together? I never imagined I'd find something so precious. Yes, %player%! A thousand times yes!
You've already made my days brighter. I can only imagine what a lifetime by your side would be like. Let's make it happen!
I don't need a grand castle or a mountain of gold. If I can spend my days with you, that's more than enough. I accept!
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.marriage_de: That's a wonderful thought, but I don't think I'm ready to make such a promise. Please give me a little more time.
Marriage is no small matter, %player%. I care about you, but I cannot say yes just yet. I hope you understand.
I wish I could give you the answer you're hoping for, but something tells me we're not quite there yet.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.procreation: Let's not get ahead of ourselves, shall we? Even the strongest adventurers need time to recover.
Patience, %player%. Some things simply cannot be rushed, no matter how eager you might be.
I think we should enjoy a little peace and quiet for now. There's no need to hurry these things.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.talk.1: There's something fascinating about the old ruins east of here. They say the stones remember things that even the oldest books have forgotten.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.talk.2: I've always believed that a person is defined by the choices they make, not the treasures they collect. Though a little treasure certainly doesn't hurt.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.talk.3: The nights have been getting colder lately. I should probably gather some wood before the frost settles in. Wouldn't want to spend winter shivering.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.talk.4: You know, sometimes I wonder what's beyond the mountains. New lands, forgotten kingdoms, perhaps even a dragon or two. A person can dream.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.talk.5: You know, %player%, I've always wondered what drives people to travel so far from home. Is it the excitement of discovering new places, the promise of great treasures, or simply the desire to see what lies beyond the horizon?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.talk.6: I like that! There's something wonderful about seeing a place for the very first time. The world is full of surprises.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.1.talk.7: Hah! Can't blame you for that. A little gold makes all those dangerous journeys worthwhile!
